title: Affine Gaussian noise stability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^2$ under the product standard Gaussian measure. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the Gaussian noise stability of $x\mapsto af(x)+b$ is $a^2$ times the stability of $f$, plus $2ab$ times the Gaussian mean of $f$, plus $b^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ belongs to $L^2$ under the product standard Gaussian measure
